fact: A total of 21 trials encompassing 99,599 patients were included.
fact_zh: 总共纳入了21项试验，涉及99,599名患者。
quote: A total of 21 trials encompassing 99,599 patients were included.

fact: Eight different GLP-1 RAs were used (lixisenatide, liraglutide, exenatide, semaglutide, efpeglenatide, dulaglutide, albiglutide, and tirzepatide), each administered at therapeutic doses and compared vs placebo or controls.
fact_zh: 使用了八种不同的GLP-1 RAs（利西那肽、利拉鲁肽、艾塞那肽、司美格鲁肽、埃夫普格列肽、杜拉鲁肽、阿利鲁肽和替瑞帕肽），每种药物均以治疗剂量给药，并与安慰剂或对照组进行比较。
quote: Eight different GLP-1 RAs were used (lixisenatide, liraglutide, exenatide, semaglutide, efpeglenatide, dulaglutide, albiglutide, and tirzepatide), each administered at therapeutic doses and compared vs placebo or controls.

fact: GLP-1 RAs reduced all-cause death (incidence rate ratio [IRR]: 0.88; 95% CI: 0.84-0.92; needed to treat [NNT] = 121), compared with controls.
fact_zh: 与对照组相比，GLP-1 RAs降低了全因死亡率（发病率比[IRR]：0.88；95% CI：0.84-0.92；需要治疗人数[NNT] = 121）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs reduced all-cause death (incidence rate ratio [IRR]: 0.88; 95% CI: 0.84-0.92; needed to treat [NNT] = 121), compared with controls.

fact: GLP-1 RAs reduced CV death (IRR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.81-0.92; NNT = 170), compared with controls.
fact_zh: 与对照组相比，GLP-1 RAs降低了心血管死亡率（IRR：0.87；95% CI：0.81-0.92；NNT = 170）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs reduced CV death (IRR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.81-0.92; NNT = 170), compared with controls.

fact: GLP-1 RAs reduced MACE (IRR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.83-0.91; NNT = 66), compared with controls.
fact_zh: 与对照组相比，GLP-1 RAs降低了主要不良心血管事件（MACE）（IRR：0.87；95% CI：0.83-0.91；NNT = 66）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs reduced MACE (IRR: 0.87; 95% CI: 0.83-0.91; NNT = 66), compared with controls.

fact: GLP-1 RAs reduced serious adverse events (-9%), myocardial infarction (-15%), acute kidney failure (-9%), heart failure (-15%), and infections (-10%), compared with controls.
fact_zh: 与对照组相比，GLP-1 RAs降低了严重不良事件（-9%）、心肌梗死（-15%）、急性肾衰竭（-9%）、心力衰竭（-15%）和感染（-10%）。
quote: GLP-1 RAs reduced serious adverse events (-9%), myocardial infarction (-15%), acute kidney failure (-9%), heart failure (-15%), and infections (-10%), but increased gastrointestinal (+63%) and gallbladder (+26%) disorders.

fact: GLP-1 RAs increased gastrointestinal (+63%) and gallbladder (+26%) disorders, compared with controls.
fact_zh: 与对照组相比，GLP-1 RAs增加了胃肠道（+63%）和胆囊（+26%）疾病的发生率。
quote: GLP-1 RAs reduced serious adverse events (-9%), myocardial infarction (-15%), acute kidney failure (-9%), heart failure (-15%), and infections (-10%), but increased gastrointestinal (+63%) and gallbladder (+26%) disorders.

fact: There were no differences in stroke, pancreatitis, or neoplasm between groups.
fact_zh: 组间在中风、胰腺炎或肿瘤方面没有差异。
quote: There were no differences in stroke, pancreatitis, or neoplasm between groups.

fact: Results were mostly consistent across subgroups.
fact_zh: 结果在各亚组中基本一致。
quote: Results were mostly consistent across subgroups.
